race.comment: ICEWATER (8) wasn't far away two back over 1590m at Ballina then found 1000m too sharp but ran a decent race at Casino last start. Back in his right race today and looks ready to break a win drought on the six-day turnaround. STAR OF WINSTON (2) made it two wins from his last three starts when he closed too well for GOLD PUMA over this track and distance last time out. Loves racing here so although getting up in the weights he is one of the chief contenders again. PRINCE OF PROPHETS (1) returned from a five-month spell with a fast-finishing second over 1181m at this circuit recently. Down in class today and is far better placed out to this trip. Good second-up performer who is a genuine contender. WHO LOVES A HARLEY (4) scored two back then was poor at the Beaumont track last start. Worth another chance. GOLD PUMA (13) has found a little bit of form and generally races well at Grafton.
